# crosswork_resource_pools (Resource)

This resource can manage an ID pool of the NSO resource allocator.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_resource_pools" "example" {
  name        = "cwtest-pool"
  range_start = 1
  range_end   = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Pool name, made of letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and dots. A service refers to the pool by this name.
- `range_end` (Number) Last id of the pool, not below the first
  - Range: `0`-`4294967295`
- `range_start` (Number) First id of the pool
  - Range: `0`-`4294967295`

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_resource_pools.example "<name>"
```
